title: Release, Delivery & Scrum Lead
description:
**ABOUT SIGHTVIEW**

Sightview Software LLC provides a suite of industry-leading software specifically geared toward ophthalmology and optometry practices — practice management, surgical, revenue cycle management (RCM), MIPS reporting, and more. Sightview is a one-stop shop for eye care specialists and their patients.

**Engagement** • **Integrity** • **Collaboration** • **Resilience** • **Accountability**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Release & Delivery Lead is the single accountable owner of how Sightview ships. This role owns the release calendar and Change Control Board process end-to-end, defines and enforces the checkpoints before, during, and after every deployment, and keeps internal teams and customer-facing stakeholders informed of what’s coming, when, and what it means for them. The Release & Delivery Lead also serves as Scrum Master for one or more delivery teams, bringing agile discipline to planning and execution, and partners closely with Engineering, QA, DevOps, Product, and Support to protect the reliability of every release our customers depend on for patient care.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Release Coordination**

* Own the release calendar for our products and coordinate scope, timing, and readiness with Engineering, QA, DevOps, Product, and Support.
* Run the Change Control Board (CCB) process, gather decision evidence, and coach the organization on the process elements.
* Facilitate release readiness (go/no-go) reviews and bring the right people together to assess tradeoffs and reach go/no-go decisions based on clear entry/exit criteria.
* Track release scope in Jira (fix versions, release tickets, dependencies) and keep status visible to stakeholders.
* Identify and track release risks, dependencies, and blockers early, and drive them to resolution or escalation in partnership with stakeholders.

**Deployment Process and Checkpoints**

* Document and maintain the pre-, intra-, and post-deployment processes, checklists, and runbooks in Confluence.
* Define clear checkpoints and owners for each phase: code freeze, regression sign-off, change approval, deployment window, smoke testing, rollback decision, and post-release validation.
* Coordinate live deployment events and act as the single point of coordination while a release is in flight.
* Lead post-release reviews and retrospectives, capture lessons learned, and turn them into process improvements.
* Keep release documentation audit-ready for regulated and compliance-driven reviews.

**Agile Delivery**

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more teams: facilitate planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coach teams and stakeholders on Scrum and Agile practices, and remove impediments to delivery.
* Help plan and align work across teams (PI Planning or equivalent) and manage cross-team dependencies.
* Track and report delivery metrics such as velocity, predictability, cycle time, release frequency, and escaped defects.

**Communication**

* Own internal release communications: release plans, deployment notices, status updates, and outage or maintenance notices.
* Partner with Product, Support, Customer Success, and Marketing on customer-facing communications, including release notes, maintenance windows, and feature announcements.
* Keep Support and customer-facing teams ready for each release with known issues, changes that affect workflows, and FAQs.
* Give leadership concise, reliable updates on release health and delivery status.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in software delivery, release management, or agile project delivery.
* 3+ years as a Scrum Master on software development teams.
* A proven record of coordinating production releases across several teams and functions.
* Experience writing and maintaining process documentation, runbooks, and checklists.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to write a clear deployment notice for engineers and a plain-language release summary for customers or executives.
* Hands-on experience with Jira (boards, fix versions, filters/JQL, dashboards) and Confluence.
* Daily fluency with Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Excel.
* Comfort facilitating meetings with a wide range of people, from engineers to executives to customers.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle several release trains and deadlines.
* Enough technical grounding to follow deployment pipelines, environments, and release risks, and to ask engineers the right questions.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience as a Release Train Engineer (RTE) in SAFe, or leading releases across several Scrum teams (Scrum of Scrums).
* Certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), PSM, CSM, or ITIL 4 Foundation.
* A technical background, such as prior work as a developer, QA engineer, systems administrator, or DevOps engineer.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), environment management, and rollback strategies.
* Health IT experience, especially EHR/EMR, practice management, or other clinical software.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS products and customer-facing maintenance windows.
* Experience in regulated environments, such as HIPAA, ONC Health IT Certification, or SOC 2.
* Experience with ITSM or change management practices (CAB, change records, release approvals).
* Experience working alongside a support organization (for example HubSpot or Zendesk) to connect releases with customer issues.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Regular use of a keyboard, mouse, and monitor, requiring repetitive hand and wrist motion
* Ability to communicate clearly by phone, video conference, and in person
* Ability to read and interpret information on a computer screen and in printed documents
* Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching within a home or office environment
* Ability to occasionally lift and move office supplies or equipment weighing up to 15 pounds

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Compensation for this role is paid in local currency and will be confirmed based on experience, qualifications, and location. [Benefits package to be confirmed — this role is based in India or the Philippines and is expected to be administered through Sightview’s local employer-of-record provider rather than Sightview’s U.S. benefits plans; do not default to the U.S. medical/dental/vision/401(k) package used on domestic JDs.]

**BACKGROUND CHECK & DRUG-FREE WORKPLACE**

[Confirm background-check and any drug-testing requirements with local counsel or Sightview’s employer-of-record provider before posting — the standard U.S. paragraph used on domestic JDs, including the marijuana-testing carve-out, may not apply or be appropriate for a role based in India or the Philippines.]

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

Sightview is an equal opportunity employer and recruits, hires, trains, and promotes without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law in the country where this role is based. [Confirm the specific protected-characteristic language applicable under India/Philippines law with local counsel before posting — the U.S. Title VII/ADA-style list used on domestic JDs does not map directly to either jurisdiction.]

title: Director of Product
description:
This Director , product Management will be responsible for designing, developing, and overseeing innovations in core Clearwater investment data management platform namely Single Data Plane . Our market leading, cloud native, single instance multi-tenant architecture intakes data from thousands of sources and creates a golden source of truth.

Reporting to VP, Product Management based in the U.S, this role will oversee defining the product requirements and planning its development to production and working closely with clients to make them successful. Additionally, the Product Manager is tasked with crafting the product roadmap necessary to achieve bookings, client NPS, and gross margin targets associated with their component.

To facilitate growth, the product manager will collaborate with internal stakeholders, clients, and prospects to identify new product capability requirements. They maintain close collaboration with their development teams to ensure the successful creation and introduction of these new capabilities to the market. Furthermore, the Product Manager takes charge of testing and implementing these fresh features with clients and actively promotes future growth to a broader audience of Clearwater clients and prospects.

**Responsibilities:**

* Team Span: responsible for handling 2 – 3 scrum teams spanning 12 – 15 engineers
* Continuously evaluate current data platform, and build a short (0 – 6 months), medium (6 – 12 months) and longer-term roadmap for a highly scalable, automated and resilient data platform
* Prioritize decisions across products with data driven justification
* Establish alignment on the product roadmap among multiple development teams.
* Efficiently lead the development of cross-product capabilities.
* Contribute to the formulation of the department's development and training plan.
* Advocate for a culture of communication throughout the organization.
* Build release specific product briefs that articulate the client problem for target personas, value, priority and high-level approach
* Keep current with latest technology development in data management, competitors and apply those insights to CW product strategy and execution.

**Required Skills:**

  

* Prior experience in Investment management industry with strong knowledge of Security Reference, Trade, Analytics, Pricing, Accounting(ABOR/IBOR) , Performance, Custody data domains is a must have.
* Proven ability to manage roadmaps for data Ingestion platforms , Data management feature/functions (Data Quality, Data Governance, Information delivery etc.) including execution, implementation, and influencing skills within the asset management space.
* 8+ years of experience of as a Product Manager (Ideal but not vital) that owns all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle in a B2B enterprise SaaS environment.
* Knowledge of investments and investment accounting (Very important)
* At least 5 years of experience in structured financial data management platforms across one or more of these: master data management, ETL/ELT, data warehousing or data lake house
* Exemplary interpersonal, communication, and project management skills
* Excellent team and relationship building abilities, with both internal and external parties (engineers, business stakeholders, partners, etc.).
* Ability to work well under pressure, multitask, and maintain keen attention to detail.
* Strong leadership skills, including ability to influence via diplomacy and tact.
* Experience working with Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Ability to work with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities.

**Education Background:**

* Bachelor's/master’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.
* In absence of a technical education, proven hands-on technical experience will be required.
* CFA is preferred

title: Project Manager / Scrum Master
description:
We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Project Manager** with **4–5 years of experience** in managing software development projects from initiation through delivery.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for **project planning, execution, stakeholder management, team coordination, risk management, delivery tracking, and ensuring projects are delivered within agreed timelines, scope, and quality standards**.

The candidate should have strong knowledge of **Agile/Scrum methodologies**, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work closely with engineering, QA, UI/UX, product, and business teams.

Key ResponsibilitiesProject Planning \& Execution

* Own and manage end\-to\-end software development projects from initiation to successful delivery.
* Define project scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, and timelines.
* Prepare and maintain project plans, schedules, resource plans, and delivery roadmaps.
* Track project progress against timelines, scope, budget, and quality expectations.
* Identify dependencies and ensure timely resolution of project blockers.
* Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed SLAs and client expectations.

Team Management \& Coordination

* Coordinate with Developers, QA Engineers, UI/UX Designers, Business Analysts, Product Managers, and other stakeholders.
* Facilitate daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Ensure clear allocation of tasks and responsibilities across project teams.
* Monitor team capacity, workload, productivity, and delivery commitments.
* Support teams in resolving technical and operational dependencies.

Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as a primary point of contact for project\-related communication with clients and stakeholders.
* Conduct regular project status meetings and provide clear progress updates.
* Manage expectations regarding timelines, scope, priorities, and deliverables.
* Prepare and present project status reports, dashboards, and metrics.
* Proactively communicate risks, issues, dependencies, and changes to stakeholders.

Risk \& Issue Management

* Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Maintain project RAID logs covering Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately and drive them toward resolution.
* Manage scope changes and assess their impact on timelines and resources.
* Ensure proper change management throughout the project lifecycle.

Agile \& Delivery Management

* Drive Agile/Scrum\-based project execution.
* Work closely with Product Owners/Managers to maintain and prioritize product backlogs.
* Track sprint velocity, burndown/burnup, cycle time, and other delivery metrics.
* Ensure sprint commitments are realistic and achievable.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve project delivery processes.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain project documentation including:
* Project plans
* Sprint plans
* Status reports
* RAID logs
* Meeting minutes
* Risk and issue trackers
* Release plans
* Project dashboards
* Ensure project documentation is accurate and up to date.
* Prepare weekly/monthly project reports for management and clients.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Management, or a related field.
* **4–5 years of experience in Project Management within an IT/software development environment.**
* Strong understanding of **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Experience managing cross\-functional software development teams.
* Strong understanding of project planning, estimation, scheduling, and delivery management.
* Excellent stakeholder and client management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects/priorities simultaneously.
* Strong ownership and accountability for project outcomes.

Technical / Tools Knowledge

Experience with one or more of the following tools is preferred:

* Jira
* Confluence
* Azure DevOps
* Trello
* Asana
* Microsoft Project
* ClickUp
* Slack / Microsoft Teams
* Google Workspace / Microsoft Office

Good understanding of software technologies such as:

* Web \& Mobile Application Development
* APIs \& Microservices
* Cloud Platforms – AWS / Azure / GCP
* Databases
* CI/CD and DevOps concepts
* QA \& Testing processes
* AI/ML and emerging technologies – added advantage

**Note:** The candidate is not required to be a hands\-on developer but should have sufficient technical understanding to effectively communicate with engineering teams.

Preferred Certifications

Any of the following certifications will be an added advantage:

* PMP
* PMI\-ACP
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)
* Professional Scrum Master (PSM)
* PRINCE2
* SAFe

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* On\-time project delivery
* Project scope adherence
* Sprint/release predictability
* Client satisfaction
* Resource utilization
* Risk and issue resolution
* Project quality
* Team productivity
* Stakeholder communication effectiveness

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Ownership\-driven** and accountable for project outcomes.
* Strong at planning and execution.
* Comfortable working with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proactive in identifying and resolving project risks.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced technology environment.
* Strong in communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management.
* Able to manage ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Focused on quality, timelines, and customer satisfaction.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Capability analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product or Capability Management experience driving technology enabled initiatives in Contact Center applications
* Develop, maintain, and oversee delivery of the product roadmap for Contact Center Applications
* Define the vision for Optum's Contact Center platform in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and business partners to understand and anticipate their needs
* Translate business need into clearly documented requirements and work with Technical Product Owner/Delivery leads to refine as appropriate
* Collaborate with a cross\-functional team of designers, business analysts, developers, testers and others to develop and execute against Product Roadmaps and Release Plans
* Ability to write and manage business requirement documents, mapping documents and functional specifications. Act as the liaison between business, developers, and project management groups
* Continuously and transparently communicate with internal stakeholders the prioritization of the Product Backlog and the status of development efforts via Product Demos and Release Plans
* Work with Scrum Masters to help direct, motivate, and guide the delivery teams
* Provide direction and support to development and quality assurance teams
* Work concurrently on several projects, each with specific instructions that may differ
* Work independently on projects, where tasks are self\-determined and not specifically assigned
* Build positive professional relationships with internal and external customers
  

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* BE/ B.Tech /MCA/M. Tech/MBA
* CSPO or POPM certification
* 7\+ years of relevant experience in US Healthcare/ Contact Center industry
* 5\+ years of product owner / product management experience
* Experience in Creating User Stories, Features
* Understanding of Contact center architecture
* Familiarity with AI and related Use cases in contact center industry
* Working knowledge of CA Rally /Aha/Jira, etc
* Proven solid Communication skill
* Flexibility with working on USA overlap shift timings (3:30 pm to 1:00 AM)

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience of any contact center platform like Amazon Connect/Genesys
* Experience of working in a contact center

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior IT Program & Project Management Analyst
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission\-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments \- creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  

  

**Job Track Description:**


The Senior IT Program \& Project Management Analyst is responsible for supporting the planning, execution, governance, reporting, and delivery of IT projects. This role partners with delivery teams, business stakeholders, product owners, and technology leaders to ensure successful delivery of IT initiatives.


The position provides PMO leadership, project controls, portfolio reporting, risk and issue management, schedule governance, resource planning support, and executive\-level communications while driving consistency with organizational project management standards and best practices.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project Governance**


* Support execution of multiple IT projects across the organization.
* Establish and maintain project governance processes, standards, and controls.
* Facilitate project reviews and status reporting.
* Ensure compliance with project management methodologies and organizational standards.
* Track project performance against scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.

**Planning and Delivery Management**


* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify schedule variances.
* Support release planning, implementation planning, and delivery readiness activities.

**Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management**


* Maintain project risk, issue, action item, and decision logs.
* Facilitate identification, assessment, and mitigation of delivery risks.
* Escalate critical issues and dependencies to leadership with recommended corrective actions.
* Monitor mitigation plans through resolution.

**Reporting and Executive Communication**


* Prepare executive\-level project status reports.
* Develop dashboards, KPIs, and portfolio metrics.
* Present project health, risks, achievements, and delivery forecasts to leadership.
* Generate management reports using project management and reporting tools.

**Financial Management**


* Assist with project budget monitoring and financial reporting.
* Track project expenditures and identify budget variances.

**Stakeholder Management**


* Collaborate with business leaders, technology teams, vendors, and customers.
* Facilitate meetings, workshops, planning sessions, and governance reviews.
* Drive stakeholder alignment on priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Ensure effective communication across all levels of the organization.

**PMO Process Improvement**


* Identify opportunities for improving project delivery processes.
* Drive adoption of Agile, Scrum, SAFe, and project management best practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across the PMO.

**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in IT project management, PMO, or project governance roles.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise technology initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, and SAFe.
* Experience managing cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.

**Required Skills**


* Project management
* Project planning and scheduling
* Risk and issue management
* Stakeholder management
* Financial and resource management
* Executive reporting and presentations
* Requirements tracking and traceability
* Change management
* Vendor management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Preferred Tools Experience**


* Microsoft Project
* Azure DevOps (ADO)
* Microsoft Office
* Microsoft Power BI

**Preferred Certifications**


* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* SAFe Agilist (SA)
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* Scrum Master Certification
